name: Add, complete, delete and retain a task
description: Checks the primary task workflow and confirms task changes remain saved in the browser.
steps: Open Tasks and add a task named 'Read for ten minutes'
Complete the task and observe the Little Wins count
Refresh the page and confirm the completed task remains
Delete the task
expected: The task is created, completion updates Little Wins, the completed state survives refresh, and deletion removes the task.

name: Navigate calendar dates and show task markers
description: Verifies month navigation and that dates with tasks are marked and show their associated tasks.
steps: Open Calendar
Move to the next month and back
Select a date and add a task for that date
Return to Calendar and inspect the selected date
expected: The month changes in both directions, the date with a task displays a dot, and selecting it shows the task for that date.

name: Open account pages
description: Checks that the account menu exposes its secondary pages without adding extra primary navigation tabs.
steps: Open the account menu
Open Dashboard and view task totals
Return and open Statistics
Open Settings and More
expected: Dashboard, Statistics, Settings and More open from the account menu and the primary navigation remains Tasks and Calendar only.

name: Prevent an empty task from being saved
description: Ensures the add sheet cannot save a task without a title.
steps: Open the add task sheet
Leave the task title empty
Inspect the Save task control
expected: The Save task control is disabled and no empty task is added.

name: Create, edit and delete a detailed calendar event
description: Verifies calendar events can be created with full details, edited, deleted and retained after refreshing.
steps: Open Calendar on desktop and choose Create
Enter a title, date, start and end time, location and description
Choose a pastel colour and save the event
Open the event block, change its location and save
Refresh the page and confirm the updated event remains
Delete the event
expected: The event appears on the correct date and time with its selected pastel colour, can be edited, survives refresh and can be deleted.

name: Navigate desktop calendar views and create an event from a time slot
description: Checks month, week and day layouts and confirms a selected hourly slot pre-fills the event time.
steps: Open Calendar and switch between Month, Week and Day
Navigate to the next week and return to Today
Click an hourly slot in Week view
Save an event with a title
expected: Each view displays the appropriate dates, navigation changes the displayed period, and the new event appears at the selected time.

name: Validate event details and preserve the mobile calendar
description: Verifies invalid event details are blocked and the compact mobile calendar remains usable.
steps: Open Calendar on mobile and add an event
Leave the title empty and inspect Save event
Enter a title but set the end time earlier than the start time
Correct the time range and save
expected: Saving is disabled until a title is present and the end time is later than the start; after saving, the event appears in the selected day's mobile event list.
